hits.title: Newsletter of the Irish Family History Forum
hits.creator: Irish Family History Forum (New York)
notes: Indexed in PERiodical Source Index (PERSI) under NYIF.

Newsletter features articles about methodology, resources, repositories, research aids, and historical topics relevant to Irish family history, including reviews of monthly their presentations, queries, a beginning genealogy column, and other items interesting to those engaged in genealogical research of Irish records from Australia, Ireland, Canada, New York and elsewhere in the United States. In the 1700s, some Irishmen immigrated to Quebec (Canada), Australia, Michigan, Minnesota, and New York (Long Island). Later descendants also lived New Brunswick, Newfoundland, and Ontario (Canada), throughout the United Kingdom, and California, Colorado, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Iowa, Massachusetts, Montana, Michigan, New Jersey, North Carolina, Ohio, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington, and elsewhere. Vol. 8 numbers 1 & 4 contain a series on the Roman Catholic Parishes in the five boroughs of New York City, which includes starting dates, current contact information, and map location of the parishes. These resources are valuable in determining the parish an ancestor most likely attended at a particular point in time. The newsletter also provides biographical sketches, source lists, obituaries, reunion reports, Irish Family History Forum business, reports of meetings or gatherings, and reviews of other published works. Information such as baptisms, marriages, and deaths are extracted from cemetery, census, church, and immigration records, civil, draft, and parish registers, letters, newspapers, passenger lists, tithes, tombstone inscriptions, and other sources. A table of contents listing back issues, the articles, their authors, and descriptions of data therein appears on the web site under the heading, "Index.".
